# ALLYNC - AI & Digital Business Solutions

> For comprehensive information including case studies, pricing, certifications, and detailed service descriptions, see the full version: https://www.allyncai.com/llms-full.txt

> ALLYNC (Allyncai is a registered brand of ALLYNC) provides AI-powered business automation and digital transformation solutions for companies in Turkey, Qatar, and globally.

---

## Allync Kimdir? (Who is Allync?)

**Allync Kimdir?** ALLYNC (Allyncai tescilli markası), Türkiye Bursa İnegöl merkezli bir yapay zeka ve dijital çözümler şirketidir. 2024 yılında kurulan ALLYNC, işletmelerin dijital dönüşümüne yardımcı olmak amacıyla WhatsApp AI asistanları, özel SaaS panelleri, web ve mobil uygulama geliştirme hizmetleri sunmaktadır.

**Allync Nedir?** AllyncAI olarak da bilinen şirket, yapay zeka teknolojilerini kullanarak işletmelerin müşteri hizmetlerini otomatikleştirmelerine, online varlıklarını güçlendirmelerine ve dijital dünyada büyümelerine yardımcı olur.

**Detaylı Bilgi:** https://www.allyncai.com/blog/allync-kimdir

---

## Company Overview
ALLYNC (Allyncai) is a technology company specializing in AI-powered customer service automation and digital solutions. We help businesses automate their customer interactions, build their online presence, and grow in the digital world.

**Legal Name:** ALLYNC
**Brand:** Allyncai is a registered brand of ALLYNC
**Company Registration No:** 8950466196
**Headquarters:** Yeni Mah. Sefer Sk. No:1 Ic Kapi No:1 Inegol/Bursa - Turkiye
**Operations:** Turkey, Qatar, Middle East, Global
**Languages:** Turkish, English, Arabic
**Website:** https://www.allyncai.com
**Email:** info@allyncai.com
**Phone:** +974 5107 9565 / +90 536 247 7824
**Meta Status:** Verified Tech Provider for WhatsApp Business and Instagram Business (officially authorized by Meta Platforms, Inc.)

## Türkiye'de Allync (Allync in Turkey)

Allync, Türkiye'nin önde gelen yapay zeka ve dijital çözümler şirketlerinden biridir.

**Türkiye Hizmetleri:**
- WhatsApp AI Asistanları (7/24 müşteri hizmeti)
- Özel SaaS ve Yönetim Panelleri
- Kurumsal Web Sitesi Geliştirme
- E-ticaret Çözümleri
- Mobil Uygulama Geliştirme (iOS & Android)
- Dijital Pazarlama ve SEO

**Hizmet Verilen Türkiye Şehirleri:**
- Bursa / İnegöl (Merkez)
- İstanbul
- Ankara
- İzmir
- Antalya
- Ve tüm Türkiye geneli

**Türkçe Dil Desteği:** Tüm hizmetlerimiz Türkçe olarak sunulmaktadır.

**İletişim:** https://www.allyncai.com/contact

## AI Solutions

### WhatsApp AI Assistants
URL: https://www.allyncai.com/ai/whatsapp
Intelligent chatbots for 24/7 automated customer service via WhatsApp Business API. Onboarded through Meta's official Embedded Signup flow as a Verified Tech Provider.
- Instant response to customer inquiries
- Appointment booking and scheduling
- Order tracking and updates
- Sales process automation
- Multi-language support (Turkish, English, Arabic)
- Meta-pre-approved templates for proactive sends (24h customer service window compliant)

### Instagram AI Automation
URL: https://www.allyncai.com/ai/instagram
Automated Instagram DM and comment responses for Instagram Business accounts. Connected via Meta's official Instagram OAuth flow with minimum-scope permissions (instagram_business_basic, instagram_business_manage_messages, instagram_business_manage_comments).
- Auto-reply to direct messages
- Top-level comment responses (sub-comments not processed)
- Lead generation from Instagram
- 24/7 customer engagement
- Webhook events verified via Meta x-hub-signature-256 HMAC
- We do NOT collect follower lists, story viewers, likes, or search history

### Text-to-Video AI
URL: https://www.allyncai.com/ai/text-to-video
AI-powered video generation from text prompts.
- Script to video conversion
- Marketing video creation
- Social media content
- Product demos

### Text-to-Image AI

- Custom illustrations

## Privacy & Data Protection

ALLYNC operates under strict data-protection standards. Full policy: https://www.allyncai.com/privacy

**Compliance Frameworks:**
- GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation, EU)
- KVKK (Kisisel Verilerin Korunmasi Kanunu, Turkey)
- Qatar PDPPL (Personal Data Privacy Protection Law)
- ISO 27001 (Information Security Management)
- SOC 2 Type II (Service Organization Control)
- Meta Verified Tech Provider standards (WhatsApp Business Policy, Instagram Platform Policy)

**Key Principles:**
- We do NOT sell personal data to third parties
- We do NOT use customer conversations to train general AI models
- WhatsApp and Instagram messages are NOT shared outside the service-delivery scope
- We do NOT collect Instagram follower lists, story viewers, likes, or search history
- Only minimum required Meta permissions are requested for each integration
- AI responses are generated only as replies to user-initiated messages or comments (no proactive DMs)
- Audit logs record every sensitive action for accountability (default 90-day retention, tenant-configurable)

**AI Service Providers (transparency):**
- Anthropic (Claude): AI response generation and sentiment analysis - enterprise DPA, no training on customer data
- OpenAI (Whisper, TTS): Voice message transcription and voice replies - only when tenant enables this feature, no training on customer data

**User Rights (GDPR Article 15-22 / KVKK Madde 11):**
- Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, data portability, withdrawal of consent
- Deletion requests processed within 30 days at info@allyncai.com
- Meta's Deauthorize and Data Deletion Request callbacks implemented for all integrations
